name: fablespace-mcp-server
description: FableSpace Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for discovering, reading, and searching creative fiction web novels and writing prompts.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search published original stories on FableSpace by keyword, genre, completion status, or tags.

query.description: Search keyword for story title, synopsis, or keywords

limit.description: Number of stories to return (default 10, max 30)

tools.name: get_story_details
tools.description: Fetch detailed synopsis, author information, chapter list, and reading statistics for a specific story slug.

slug.description: The URL slug identifier of the story

tools.name: get_chapter_content
tools.description: Retrieve full readable text and author notes for a specific chapter of a story.

storySlug.description: The URL slug identifier of the story

tools.name: list_genres
tools.description: Get all available fiction genres and categories on FableSpace.

tools.name: get_writing_prompts
tools.description: Fetch active creative writing challenges and monthly themed prompts from FableSpace.
